assumptions: Daniel and Nik play fairly; no altered guesses, scores or rule exploits are needed.
Game records are prepared with the game's own season-score and save helpers. Backup downloads, choice boxes and Apply are played through the real screens in Chromium.
The downloaded backup is valid and was made by this game. The game files checked match the recorded main version.
The existing keep-current code and tests were checked first. They handle the preview correctly; they do not test this full Apply path.
title: Keep current restore removes the current Showdown and loses season progress
steps: Have a three-season Showdown with season 1 saved. Open Settings, Open History & Backup, and Export Backup.
Start another ten-season Showdown and finish nine seasons. The current game is at season 10 with a 9-9 total; both games are saved.
Choose the older downloaded backup and press Review Restore.
Choose Keep current for Active Showdown, Legacy History, Preferences and Save Library.
Read the preview: Save Library stays local; active stays local; no storage rewrite currently required.
Press Apply Restore and confirm. Reload the game.
expected: Both saved games stay as they were. The current game stays at season 10 with nine played seasons and a 9-9 total.
actual: The season-10 game disappears. Only the old backup game remains, at season 2 with one played season and a 0-0 total. Reload keeps the wrong result.
root_cause: The preview checks all saved games. Apply builds its final plan using a smaller snapshot that leaves out the Save Library. The plan mistakes the current game for an empty game and restores the entire older backup, despite the keep-current choices. Backup checks, change-after-review checks and the final write check do not catch the wrong choice.

fix.change: Pass completeRaw, including saveLibrary, to createCareerModeRestorePlan when Apply builds the final plan. Keep the existing checks before and after Apply. Use the failing screen test to verify that keep-current leaves all games and season progress unchanged.
